name: Festive Cheer
desc: The joyful energy gathered from enjoying the games at the World Food Fair during the Moonchase Festival. Beyond lifting your spirits, it seems you can even exchange it for various material rewards.

customize.name: Silver Light
customize.desc: A longsword left behind by Wind Reader, one of the Three Hermits of Guizang in Liyue. Legend has it that it was forged out of sacred silver descended from the heavens, and that it once cleaved flowing sea water into two.

customize.name: Primogem
customize.desc: A primordial crystalline gem that's beyond the mundane world. Shines with the condensed hopes and dreams of universes that once were.

customize.name: Tea-Scented Tassel
customize.desc:
Refinement material for "Silver Light."
A tassel carrying the fragrance of freshly picked tea leaves, with the spiritual power of the Wind Reader held deep within. When lightly brushed across the mithril blade, it seems to restore its keen edge.

customize.name: Philosophies of Prosperity
customize.desc:
Talent Level-Up material.
Prosperity is the people's pursuit in the land of Geo.
Prosperity is Liyue's past, present, and future. This prosperity is unmatched and unobtainable by any other nations — it all belongs to Liyue and its inhabitants.
